faqs.q: How can I raise concerns about STRs in my neighborhood?
faqs.a: The City of Arvada is committed to supporting responsible short-term rental operations while also maintaining positive relationships within our neighborhoods. If you have a concern about a short-term rental in your neighborhood, you may report it at any time using our online system, or call (720) 806-9412 to speak to a representative. In the case of an emergency, please call 911.
